method: MSU-LatentAFIS enhancement autoencoder (Cao, Nguyen, Tymoszek, Jain, TIFS 2020), retrained with MSU's recipe on our clean train prints

model._source: Model.reconstruction2 in extraction/enhancement_AEC.py. The released weights (Enhancement_AEC_128_depth_4_STFT) are no longer downloadable: the README's Google Drive folder returns 404.

training._source: batch, patch, optimiser and augmentation from enhancement_AEC.py (opt.BATCH, opt.SHAPE, _get_optimizer, ImageFromFile_AutoEcoder). MSU trained 3,000 epochs x 1,000 steps; we stop at 50k steps (same budget as the other experiments).
